title: Evidence manifest checker
statement: The repository validates every active manifest's complete nested schema, local paths and digests, object binding, trust class, pinned Axeyum revision, producer, checker result, and named negative-control failure.
scope: Active schema-version-1 manifests under artifacts/claims. The gate reproduces each declared producer and checker and requires each negative control to exit nonzero with its named failure class.

evidence.note: Four structural mutation tests exercise nested required fields, nested unknown fields, digest syntax, and nonempty semantic inputs. The live route also reproduces the producer, checks post-production digests, matches positive output, and matches the negative failure class.
